svg.text: Top view, header at the top. Strips: rows A-C and D-F of each column are joined; nothing else is.
24C -> one wire, daisy-chained to all seven buttons (GND)
Resistors and diodes stand up (hairpin); the GPIO ones have one leg in the pad itself. Diode stripe = cathode.
Transistors: base in the middle, emitter to the right. Adapter assumed G-S-D in a row: check it before soldering.
